biological.citation: Ae4 (Slc4a9) is an electroneutral monovalent cation-dependent Cl-/HCO3- exchanger (PMID: 27114614)
biological.summary: SLC4A9/AE4 functions as an electroneutral Cl-/nonselective cation-HCO3- exchanger that mediates Na+-dependent Cl-/HCO3- exchange in mouse salivary gland acinar cells and CHO-K1 cells. The transporter can also mediate K+-dependent Cl-/HCO3- exchange and electroneutral HCO3-/Na+-HCO3- exchange under Cl--free conditions. Whole cell recordings and ion concentration measurements demonstrated that Na+ is transported in the same direction as HCO3- and opposite to Cl-, with no associated changes in membrane potential.

biological.citation: A novel sodium bicarbonate cotransporter-like gene in an ancient duplicated region: SLC4A9 at 5q31 (PMID: 11305939)
biological.summary: SLC4A9 is a 23-exon gene on chromosome 5q31 encoding a 990 amino acid protein with 12 transmembrane domains and high sequence similarity to other NBC transporters. The gene exhibits abundant alternative mRNA processing with 14 known isoforms and expression is largely restricted to the kidney. The gene contains multiple alternatively spliced exons in the 3' UTR and six polyadenylation sites.

biological.citation: The transcription factor Foxi1 promotes expression of V-ATPase and Gpr116 in M-1 cells (PMID: 36603001)
biological.summary: Overexpression of the transcription factor Foxi1 in murine cortical collecting duct M-1 cells induces expression of SLC4A9 along with other intercalated cell markers (Gpr116, Atp6v1b1, Atp6v1g3, Atp6v0d2, Slc26a4), differentiating M-1 cells toward a non-A, non-B type intercalated cell phenotype. This demonstrates SLC4A9 is a Foxi1-regulated gene in renal intercalated cells.

biological.citation: The role of Na(+)-coupled bicarbonate transporters (NCBT) in health and disease (PMID: 38536494)
biological.summary: SLC4A9 (AE4) is a member of the SLC4 family of bicarbonate transporters involved in pH regulation and acid-base homeostasis. The ionic coupling of SLC4A9 remains controversial, but it plays roles in intracellular pH regulation, cell volume regulation, and salt balance. SLC4A9 is implicated in pathophysiology of cancer, glaucoma, and neurological diseases.

biological.citation: Epigenome-Wide Association Study for All-Cause Mortality in a Cardiovascular Cohort Identifies Differential Methylation in Castor Zinc Finger 1 (CASZ1) (PMID: 31642367)
biological.summary: Epigenome-wide association study identified differential methylation at probe cg08215811 in SLC4A9 associated with all-cause mortality in a cardiovascular cohort (CATHGEN). The probe showed differential methylation in both discovery (55 cases, 49 controls) and validation (108 cases, 108 controls) sets with log2 fold change of -0.14.
biological.sample_size: Discovery: 55 cases, 49 controls; Validation: 108 cases, 108 controls
biological.significance: P<0.05 in discovery; FDR-adjusted P<0.10 in validation

biological.citation: The Role of Intercalated Cell Nedd4-2 in BP Regulation, Ion Transport, and Transporter Expression (PMID: 29773687)
biological.summary: SLC4A9 (AE4) is expressed as a type B intercalated cell transporter in the cortical collecting duct. Intercalated cell Nedd4-2 gene ablation did not increase the abundance of AE4 protein, despite markedly increasing electroneutral Cl-/HCO3- exchange activity, suggesting AE4 abundance is not regulated by Nedd4-2-mediated ubiquitylation.

biological.citation: The SLC4 family of bicarbonate (HCO₃⁻) transporters (PMID: 23506864)
biological.summary: SLC4A9 (AE4) is a member of the SLC4 family of 10 genes encoding HCO3- transporters. Unlike most SLC4 members with established functions, AE4 does not yet have a firmly established function. SLC4 proteins play important roles in acid-base homeostasis, CO2 carriage, H+/HCO3- transport in epithelia, cell volume regulation, and intracellular pH regulation.

biological.citation: Insights into acidosis-induced regulation of SLC26A4 (pendrin) and SLC4A9 (AE4) transporters using three-dimensional morphometric analysis of β-intercalated cells (PMID: 24990900)
biological.summary: SLC4A9/AE4 is expressed as a barrel-like structure in the lateral membrane of β-intercalated cells in rabbit cortical collecting duct. Acidosis reduced AE4 expression in β-ICs, which was rapidly reversed during recovery from acidosis. AE4 is proposed to function in basolateral exit of Na+ via Na+-HCO3- cotransport, and its coordinate regulation with pendrin affects acid-base and Na+ transport across the collecting duct.

biological.citation: Disrupting Hypoxia-Induced Bicarbonate Transport Acidifies Tumor Cells and Suppresses Tumor Growth (PMID: 27197160)
biological.summary: Hypoxia induced robust expression of SLC4A9 in 8 of 10 cancer cell lines tested, with induction dependent on both HIF1α and HIF2α activity. SLC4A9 disruption by genetic or pharmaceutical approaches (S0859 inhibitor) in cancer cell spheroids acidified intracellular pH, reduced cell growth, and increased apoptosis. RNAi-mediated attenuation of SLC4A9 increased apoptosis in MDA-MB-231 breast cancer spheroids and dramatically reduced tumor growth in murine xenografts.
biological.sample_size: 8 of 10 cancer cell lines; MDA-MB-231 and U87 xenografts

biological.citation: Effect of heat stress on the gene expression of ion transporters/channels in the uterus of laying hens during eggshell formation (PMID: 29115887)
biological.summary: SLC4A9 transcript levels in the uterine lining were significantly decreased in heat-stressed laying hens (36-38°C for 8 weeks) compared to control hens (21-23°C), with a 66.1% reduction. This downregulation of SLC4A9 may impair transportation of Cl-, HCO3-, and Na+ during eggshell mineralization under heat stress conditions.
